body.en: Mozambique's LNG sector is no longer a forecast. TotalEnergies' Mozambique LNG project at Afungi, Cabo Delgado, has reached roughly 40% completion as of early 2026, with full project activities restarted on January 29, 2026 after the force majeure lifted in November 2025. The plant is sized for 13.1 million tonnes per annum (MTPA) of LNG, and the first cargo is now expected in 2029. TotalEnergies leads a consortium that includes ENH (Empresa Nacional de Hidrocarbonetos), Mitsui, ONGC, Bharat Petroleum, Oil India, and PTTEP. The project's EPC phase alone involves more than 30,000 tonnes of structural and piping fasteners across cryogenic, process, marine, and structural applications, sourced predominantly from South African, Chinese, and Indian manufacturers. For a B2B buyer — whether a procurement manager at a Tier-1 EPC contractor (Saipem, McDermott, Chiyoda, KBR), a maintenance lead at ENH, or an import distributor in Matola or Maputo — the question is not whether fasteners will be purchased, but whether they will arrive on time, in the right grade, and certified to the standards that Afungi's QA/QC team will physically verify. The wrong B7 stud on a low-temperature LNG pipe flange does not just fail a torque test; it becomes a brittle-fracture liability that can halt a $20B project. This guide maps the engineering requirements, supply-chain reality, and commercial pitfalls of sourcing fasteners for the Mozambique LNG corridor in 2026 — from the DP World terminal in Maputo to the Afungi construction site roughly 1,800 km north. body.zh: 莫桑比克 LNG（液化天然气）行业已不再是预测阶段。截至 2026 年初，TotalEnergies 位于德尔加杜角省 Afungi 的莫桑比克 LNG 项目已完成约 40%；不可抗力状态于 2025 年 11 月解除后，项目全部作业已于 2026 年 1 月 29 日全面重启。装置规划年产能为 1,310 万吨 LNG（MTPA），首船液化天然气预计于 2029 年发运。TotalEnergies 牵头的联合体成员包括 ENH（Empresa Nacional de Hidrocarbonetos，国家碳氢化合物公司）、三井、ONGC、Bharat Petroleum、Oil India 与 PTTEP。仅项目 EPC 阶段就涉及超过 30,000 吨结构与管道紧固件，覆盖低温、工艺、海事及结构各类应用，主要采购自南非、中国和印度制造商。 对 B2B 采购方而言——无论是 Saipem、McDermott、Chiyoda、KBR 这类一级 EPC 承包商的采购经理，还是 ENH 的维护负责人，或是 Matola、Maputo 的进口经销商——关键问题不在于会不会采购紧固件，而在于货物能否准时到达、牌号是否正确，以及证书能否通过 Afungi QA/QC 团队的现场核验。低温 LNG 管道法兰上误用一根 B7 螺柱，后果不只是扭矩测试不合格；它会成为脆性断裂隐患，足以导致一个 $20B 项目停工。 本指南梳理了 2026 年莫桑比克 LNG 通道紧固件采购的工程要求、供应链现实与商业风险点，范围覆盖从 Maputo 的 DP World 码头到以北约 1,800 km 的 Afungi 施工现场。相关产品：高强度螺栓 地脚螺栓 不锈钢紧固件 六角螺栓 锁紧螺母 垫圈 自钻螺钉 内六角螺钉。

body.en:
A widespread mistake in early-stage LNG procurement is specifying ASTM A193 B7 studs across the board because B7 is the "default" high-temperature alloy stud for refineries and power plants. The problem: LNG service operates at approximately -162°C (-259°F). ASTM A193 B7's standard lower service limit is -45°C (-50°F). Going below that without supplementary Charpy V-notch impact testing at -101°C produces a stud that, in the field, can fail by brittle cleavage fracture with no plastic deformation — the textbook cause of LNG storage and piping leaks.
The correct specification map for Mozambique LNG:
- Cryogenic bolting (LNG storage tanks, primary liquefaction piping, cold box internals, vaporizers): ASTM A320 Grade L7 (quenched and tempered alloy steel, mandatory Charpy V-notch impact testing at -101°C) or L7M. - 一般非低温工艺管道（蒸气回流管线、胺系统、再生塔）：ASTM A193 B7 并补充 -45°C S5 冲击试验即可接受；在 0°C 以上烃类工况的 ASME B16.5 Class 150# 至 Class 2500# 法兰上，B7 同样适用。

body.en:
The Port of Maputo, operated by MPDC (Portos de Maputo) with DP World running the container terminal, set a historic throughput record in 2025: 32.0 million tonnes of cargo, up 3.4% year-on-year from 30.9 Mt in 2024. Rail volumes into the port grew 17% in the same window, from 9.7 Mt to 11.7 Mt, reflecting the deliberate strategy of moving bulk cargo off the EN1 highway and onto the Ressano Garcia and Limpopo rail corridors. For fastener importers, this matters because the Afungi site is roughly 1,800 km north by road via the N1 through Xai-Xai, Inhambane, Maxixe, Vilankulo, and Inhassoro — a 3-day truck convoy through territory with limited fuel, intermittent mobile coverage, and security protocols after the Cabo Delgado insurgency (now largely contained as of 2025 but still a Tier-2 risk zone).
DP World broke ground on May 1, 2025 on a $165 million container terminal expansion that will double capacity from 255,000 TEUs to 530,000 TEUs, extend the quay from 308 m to 650 m, and deepen the berth from 12 m to 16 m — enough to handle post-Panamax vessels of up to 366 m LOA. The concession runs through 2058. The expansion directly benefits fastener importers: palletized, containerized shipments of M8–M36 hex bolts, stud bolts, and structural anchors in 20- and 40-foot containers can now be staged at Maputo for onward barge movement to the Matola oil terminal or rail transfer to the Limpopo line.
Operational risks to plan around:
- 2025 customs enforcement tightening: Mozambique now mandates 8-digit HS codes for clearance. Fastener HS code 73.18 (screws, bolts, nuts, coach screws, screw hooks, rivets, cotters, cotter pins, washers and similar articles of iron or steel) covers the category. Threaded articles not elsewhere specified fall under 7318.29.00. Misclassification — common when Chinese mills code a "stud bolt" as 7307 (tubes) instead of 7318 — will trigger shipment suspension.
- CIF-based duty: Mozambique calculates customs duty on CIF value. General duty rates range 0–20%, with consumer goods at 20%. Most industrial fasteners land in the 7.5% bracket (the rate applied to 7318.29.00 under EU and SADC agreements). VAT 16% is applied on top, plus a 2.5% Tax on Sustainable Commerce (TSA).
- SADC origin optimization: As a SADC member, Mozambique grants preferential duty reductions of 0–25% versus MFN rates for goods meeting SADC Rules of Origin and accompanied by a SADC Certificate of Origin. body.en:
Chinese fastener exports into SADC and Mozambique LNG-adjacent projects run on three certification tracks. Knowing which one the EPC accepts upfront saves three to six months of approval cycle.
1. Mill Test Certificate (MTC) to EN 10204 3.1: Issued by the mill's quality department, independent of production. Required for all pressure-containing and load-bearing bolting. The MTC must show heat number, chemical analysis (C, Mn, Si, S, P, Cr, Mo, Ni, V for alloy grades), mechanical properties (tensile, yield, elongation, hardness), and for cryogenic grades, Charpy impact energy at the specified test temperature. Chinese mills such as LISI, Fortune, Tongcheng, and QFC routinely provide 3.1 certificates; small trading houses do not.
2. Third-party inspection (TPI) report to ISO 17020: Saipem, McDermott, Chiyoda, and KBR each maintain approved Third-Party Inspector lists. For Mozambique LNG, the most-cited TPIs are SGS, Bureau Veritas, TÜV Rheinland, and Intertek. The TPI agent visits the mill before shipment, witnesses heat-treatment, performs dimensional sampling, and issues a release note. Without TPI, the cargo will not be unloaded at Matola.
3. Project-specific approvals: Some EPCs require a Project Quality Plan (PQP) review and a Manufacturer Quality Plan (MQP) submittal that documents the entire production flow from wire rod to finished fastener. This is a 60–90 day engineering review; lead time is the killer, not price.
The China-to-Maputo freight flow typically follows one of three lanes: (a) Shanghai/Ningbo → Singapore → Maputo (24–28 days sea), (b) Shenzhen → Durban → road/rail to Maputo via Golela border (30+ days but consolidates with South African inventory), or (c) Shanghai → Dar es Salaam → road to Mozambique (rare, only for urgent spares). Incoterms that work for the project are FOB Shanghai (EPC arranges ocean freight, often through a project forwarder with LNG-sector expertise) and CIF Maputo (supplier handles ocean + insurance to port, buyer handles duty and inland). DDP Matola is rare because most Chinese mills cannot navigate Mozambican customs without a local agent.

1. EN 10204 3.1 工厂试验证书（MTC）：由钢厂质量部门出具，独立于生产部门。所有承压和承载螺栓均须提供。MTC 必须注明炉号、化学成分（合金牌号含 C、Mn、Si、S、P、Cr、Mo、Ni、V）、力学性能（抗拉、屈服、伸长率、硬度），低温牌号还须注明规定试验温度下的夏比冲击功。LISI、Fortune、Tongcheng、QFC 等中国钢厂常规提供 3.1 证书；小型贸易商通常不具备。
2. ISO 17020 第三方检验（TPI）报告：Saipem、McDermott、Chiyoda、KBR 各有认可的第三方检验机构名单。莫桑比克 LNG 项目最常引用的 TPI 机构为 SGS、Bureau Veritas、TÜV Rheinland 和 Intertek。TPI 代理在发货前到厂见证热处理、进行尺寸抽样，并出具放行通知。没有 TPI，货物无法在 Matola 卸货。
3. 项目专项审批：部分 EPC 要求提交项目质量计划（PQP）评审和制造商质量计划（MQP），覆盖从线材到成品紧固件的全部生产流程。这是一项 60–90 天的工程评审；周期才是瓶颈，而非价格。
中国至 Maputo 的货运通常走三条通道：(a) 上海/宁波 → 新加坡 → Maputo（海运 24–28 天）；(b) 深圳 → 德班 → 经 Golela 口岸公路/铁路至 Maputo（30 天以上，但可与南非库存拼箱）；(c) 上海 → 达累斯萨拉姆 → 公路至莫桑比克（少见，仅用于紧急备件）。项目适用的 Incoterms 为 FOB 上海（EPC 自行安排海运，通常委托具备 LNG 行业经验的项目货代）和 CIF Maputo（供应商负责海运及至港保险，买方负责关税与内陆运输）。DDP Matola 很少采用，因为多数中国钢厂没有本地代理，无法自行办理莫桑比克清关。

Chinese fastener exports into SADC and Mozambique LNG-adjacent projects run on three certification tracks. Knowing which one the EPC accepts upfront saves three to six months of approval cycle.
1. Mill Test Certificate (MTC) to EN 10204 3.1: Issued by the mill's quality department, independent of production. Required for all pressure-containing and load-bearing bolting. The MTC must show heat number, chemical analysis (C, Mn, Si, S, P, Cr, Mo, Ni, V for alloy grades), mechanical properties (tensile, yield, elongation, hardness), and for cryogenic grades, Charpy impact energy at the specified test temperature. Chinese mills such as LISI, Fortune, Tongcheng, and QFC routinely provide 3.1 certificates; small trading houses do not.
2. Third-party inspection (TPI) report to ISO 17020: Saipem, McDermott, Chiyoda, and KBR each maintain approved Third-Party Inspector lists. For Mozambique LNG, the most-cited TPIs are SGS, Bureau Veritas, TÜV Rheinland, and Intertek. The TPI agent visits the mill before shipment, witnesses heat-treatment, performs dimensional sampling, and issues a release note. Without TPI, the cargo will not be unloaded at Matola.
3. Project-specific approvals: Some EPCs require a Project Quality Plan (PQP) review and a Manufacturer Quality Plan (MQP) submittal that documents the entire production flow from wire rod to finished fastener. This is a 60–90 day engineering review; lead time is the killer, not price.
The China-to-Maputo freight flow typically follows one of three lanes: (a) Shanghai/Ningbo → Singapore → Maputo (24–28 days sea), (b) Shenzhen → Durban → road/rail to Maputo via Golela border (30+ days but consolidates with South African inventory), or (c) Shanghai → Dar es Salaam → road to Mozambique (rare, only for urgent spares). Incoterms that work for the project are FOB Shanghai (EPC arranges ocean freight, often through a project forwarder with LNG-sector expertise) and CIF Maputo (supplier handles ocean + insurance to port, buyer handles duty and inland). DDP Matola is rare because most Chinese mills cannot navigate Mozambican customs without a local agent.

body.en: A 2024 internal review of fastener rejection rates on SADC energy projects found that quotes landing 8–15% below the median typically fail at one of three checkpoints: (1) Charpy impact values not actually tested, only certified on paper; (2) dimensional tolerances out of ISO 4759-1 Product Grade A limits despite the certificate saying "A"; (3) zinc-flake coating thickness below the specified 8–12 µm because the actual deposit was 5 µm. The cost of a single rejected lot — demurrage at Maputo, back-shipment, project schedule slip — is consistently 4–8x the savings on the original quote. The right sourcing model for Mozambique LNG fasteners is the one TotalEnergies' Tier-1 EPCs already use: pre-qualified Chinese mill + South African consolidator with SADC origin + local Matola/Maputo clearing agent. The price is 5–10% above the cheapest quote. The on-time-in-full rate, in field data, runs 95–98% versus 70–80% for direct-from-mill shipments. That gap is the entire profit margin of the project. For EPCs and procurement managers evaluating suppliers now, three immediate actions: 1. Lock the grade map before RFQ issuance. Do not let a B7 default leak into cryogenic SKUs. Specify A320 L7/L7M for low-temp and B8M (A4-80) for marine, with B7 only for non-cryogenic flanges. 2. Insist on witnessed Charpy testing at the mill for any lot bound for cryogenic service, even if the order is small. The TPI's job is to physically witness the test, not accept a paper certificate. 3. Stage at Maputo, not Durban. Maputo's 2025 rail and container capacity upgrades mean a Maputo-cleared shipment can be at the Afungi laydown yard in 7–10 days. Durban adds 4–6 days of cross-border road movement and breaks the SADC origin chain. body.zh: 2024 年一项针对 SADC 能源项目紧固件拒收率的内部复盘显示：报价低于中位数 8–15% 的批次，通常在三个环节之一失守：(1) 夏比冲击值并未实测，仅在纸面上出证；(2) 尺寸公差超出 ISO 4759-1 A 级产品等级要求，证书却标注“A”；(3) 锌片涂层厚度低于规定的 8–12 µm，实际沉积仅 5 µm。单批拒收的成本——Maputo 滞港费、退运、项目工期延误——通常是原报价节省额的 4–8 倍。 莫桑比克 LNG 紧固件的正确采购模式，正是 TotalEnergies 一级 EPC 已经采用的：通过预审的中国钢厂 + 持有 SADC 原产地的南非拼箱商 + Matola/Maputo 本地清关代理。价格比最低报价高 5–10%，但现场数据显示按时足量交付率为 95–98%，而钢厂直发仅为 70–80%。这一差距就是项目的全部利润空间。 当前评估供应商的 EPC 与采购经理，可立即采取三项动作： 1. 在 RFQ 发出前锁定牌号选型图，不要让 B7 默认渗入低温物料清单：低温工况指定 A320 L7/L7M，海事工况指定 B8M（A4-80），B7 仅用于非低温法兰。 2. 凡是供低温工况的批次，无论订单大小，都坚持在钢厂现场见证夏比试验。TPI 的职责是现场见证试验，而非接受纸面证书。 3. 集货地选 Maputo 而非德班。Maputo 2025 年铁路与集装箱能力升级后，Maputo 清关的货物可在 7–10 天内运抵 Afungi 堆场；德班会增加 4–6 天跨境公路运输，并打断 SADC 原产地链条。相关产品：高强度螺栓 地脚螺栓 不锈钢紧固件 六角螺栓 锁紧螺母 垫圈 自钻螺钉 内六角螺钉。

body.en: What fastener grades does the LNG corridor actually require? Structural bolting on gas works typically follows ASTM A325 or A490 equivalents with hot dip galvanizing or zinc flake coating, while piping and flange work calls for A193 B7 or A320 L7 studs with matching nuts. Coastal exposure means coating thickness and salt spray performance matter as much as strength class. How do EPC buyers handle delivery windows? Most packages are released against construction sequence, so a supplier who can hold buffer stock in Maputo and release in phases is more useful than one who ships everything at once. Confirm whether the contract expects delivery at Maputo port, at a laydown yard, or at the site gate, because the last leg is often the schedule risk. What documentation is expected on arrival? Mill certificates, coating thickness reports, dimensional inspection records and packing lists that match the invoice line by line. Customs in Mozambique can hold a container for paperwork discrepancies, so pre shipment document review is cheaper than resolving a dispute at the port. Is local stock a realistic option? Only for common sizes. Specialized grades and large diameters are usually imported against project schedules, which is why early specification freeze matters more than price negotiation in the first weeks.

A3: 工厂证书、涂层厚度报告、尺寸检验记录，以及与发票逐行对应的装箱单。莫桑比克海关可能因单证不符扣柜，因此发货前的单证审核比在港口解决争议成本更低。

A4: 仅适用于常用规格。特殊牌号和大直径规格通常按项目计划进口，因此在项目最初几周，尽早冻结规格比价格谈判更重要。
